---
title: "Visium Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(SpatialFeatureExperiment)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(scater)
library(Voyager)
library(ggspavis)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(dbscan)
library(scuttle)
```

## Read in unfiltered samples

```{r}
base_dirs <- "~/Google Drive/My Drive/research/Cachectic_Visium/"
sample_dirs <- c("Sample_S54407_Sham1_3_5",
                 "Sample_S54410_C26Ctrl_7_9_11",
                 "Sample_S54409_C26Sh_16_18_20",
                 "Sample_S54408_C26Sh_17_19_21"
                 )

sfe <- read10xVisiumSFE(samples = paste0(base_dirs, sample_dirs), 
                        type = "sparse",
                        data = "raw", 
                        images = "lowres",
                        sample_id = c("Sham", "C26Ctrl", "C26T16", "C26T17")
                        )
sfe <- mirror(sfe)
sfe
colData(sfe)
table(sfe$in_tissue, sfe$sample_id)
```

First look at the samples

```{r}
sfe <- addPerCellQCMetrics(sfe)

plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "sum", 
                   image_id = "lowres", ncol = 2,
                   divergent=FALSE,
                   dark=TRUE)

plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "detected", 
                   image_id = "lowres", ncol = 2,
                   divergent=FALSE,
                   dark=TRUE)
```

## Filtering and sample splitting

We can filter the spots, mostly using 10X algorithm, but removing the top-right corner of C26Ctrl.

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())

plotSpatialFeature(sfe[, sfe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl"], "in_tissue")

as.data.frame(colData(sfe)) |>
    dplyr::filter(in_tissue & sample_id=="C26Ctrl") |>
    ggplot(aes(-array_row, -array_col)) +
    geom_point()
```

We need to split the samples, I would hope that a simple clustering of the coordinates will do the job.

### C26 control

```{r}
C26Ctrl <- sfe[, sfe$in_tissue & sfe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl"]
coords <- spatialCoords(C26Ctrl)

cl <- dbscan(coords, eps = 300, minPts = 10)
table(cl$cluster)

as.data.frame(colData(C26Ctrl)) |>
    ggplot(aes(-array_row, -array_col, color=as.factor(cl$cluster))) +
    geom_point()

C26Ctrl_1 <- C26Ctrl[, cl$cluster==1]
C26Ctrl_2 <- C26Ctrl[, cl$cluster==2]

plotSpatialFeature(C26Ctrl_1, features = "sum")
plotSpatialFeature(C26Ctrl_2, features = "sum")
```

### Add tissue ID to full object

```{r}
sfe$tissue_id <- rep(NA_character_, ncol(sfe))

colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="Sham",][colnames(Sham_1),"tissue_id"] <- "Sham_1"
colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="Sham",][colnames(Sham_2),"tissue_id"] <- "Sham_2"
colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="Sham",][colnames(Sham_3),"tissue_id"] <- "Sham_3"

colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26T16",][colnames(C26T16_1),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T16_1"
colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26T16",][colnames(C26T16_2),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T16_2"
colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26T16",][colnames(C26T16_3),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T16_3"

colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26T17",][colnames(C26T17_1),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T17_1"
colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26T17",][colnames(C26T17_2),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T17_2"
colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26T17",][colnames(C26T17_3),"tissue_id"] <- "C26T17_3"

colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl",][colnames(C26Ctrl_1),"tissue_id"] <- "C26Ctrl_1"
colData(sfe)[sfe$sample_id=="C26Ctrl",][colnames(C26Ctrl_2),"tissue_id"] <- "C26Ctrl_2"

sfe$tissue_id <- as.factor(sfe$tissue_id)

plotSpatialFeature(sfe, features = "tissue_id")
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis

Plot total counts and three interesting genes.

```{r}
sfe <- logNormCounts(sfe)
rownames(sfe) <- rowData(sfe)$symbol

plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "Trim63")
plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "Foxo1")
plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "Foxo3")

saveRDS(sfe, file="sfe_annotated.rds")
```

### PCA of pseudobulk

```{r}
# create pseudobulk
pb <- aggregateAcrossCells(sfe, ids=sfe$tissue_id)
pb <- computeLibraryFactors(pb)
pb <- logNormCounts(pb)
pb <- runPCA(pb, BSPARAM = BiocSingular::ExactParam(), ncomponents=10)
plotPCA(pb, color_by = "tissue_id", point_size=4)
```

```{r}
rownames(pb) <- rowData(pb)$symbol
feats <- rownames(pb)[which(rowData(pb)$symbol %in% c("Trim63", "Foxo1", "Foxo3"))]
plotHeatmap(pb, feats, color_columns_by = "sample_id")
```
